name: chronicler-plugin-toolkit
description: The fixed set of npm packages a plugin may import with NOTHING to declare in its manifest. The server's esbuild resolves plugin imports against this node_modules (baked into the image at /app/node_modules), so these packages are 'already shipped'. Anything outside this set must go in a plugin's manifest "dependencies" and needs npm available at build time. Keep this list in sync with chronicle-plugin-template's import guidance.
